About.Title: About
About.AuthorContent: Hi, I’m {name}, a full-stack developer. I’m interested in frontend engineering, the React ecosystem, and developer experience. I’m also exploring how AI coding tools fit into my day-to-day work.
About.AuthorMotivation: In college, I wanted a blog of my own where I could choose how to publish my technical notes and show what I could build for the web. I finally started building it in mid-2026.
About.BlogContent: I built Ruixe Blog with Next.js 16 and HeroUI v3. I keep both the Chinese and English posts in MDX files.
About.BuildStory: I wrote about the technical choices and the work of getting the site online in <story>The Birth of My Personal Blog Website</story>.
